title: Typography and readability
summary: Typography and readability operational rules curated for Zanker. Independent synthesis; consult primary sources for exact normative requirements.

rules.title: Semantic type scale
rules.intent: Use restrained size/weight scale with clear heading structure
principles: Use restrained size/weight scale with clear heading structure
antiPatterns: Arbitrary font sizes in each component

rules.title: Line length and rhythm
rules.intent: Constrain long prose line length for readability
principles: Constrain long prose line length for readability
antiPatterns: Long line spans on ultrawide monitors
acceptance: Copy remains comfortable on desktop and mobile

rules.title: Font fallback and rendering
rules.intent: Provide stable fallbacks and appropriate font loading behavior
principles: Provide stable fallbacks and appropriate font loading behavior
antiPatterns: Fonts that cause major layout shifts

rules.title: Tabular alignment
rules.intent: Use tabular numerals when scanning columns of values
principles: Use tabular numerals when scanning columns of values
antiPatterns: Variable glyph widths misalign financial comparisons

rules.title: Weight contrast and scale
rules.intent: Use contrast among size, weight, space without excess color
principles: Use contrast among size, weight, space without excess color
antiPatterns: All emphasis achieved through saturated colors

rules.title: Localization resilience
rules.intent: Verify typography with accents and longer translations
principles: Verify typography with accents and longer translations
